Amethyst 1.18.0 can now use a local NIP-85 trust index to separate known contacts from new requests.

The client downloads kind 30382 assertions from the provider named in the user's kind 10040 event, verifies the signatures and builds a local index. The chosen score threshold can then shape DM tabs, curated notifications, collapsed replies and profile badges without a relay subscription for every profile.

That remains delegated judgment, not objective reputation. A valid signature proves which provider made the assertion, not that its ranking is correct. Provider and threshold stay configurable, and filtering waits for a complete index.

The same release replaces the old desktop interface with the shared Android application shell and publishes Linux, Windows and Apple Silicon builds.
